title: Fixed Open Clamshell Portable Computer
description: One newly authored complete fixed-open portable computer exterior: a thin whole lower chassis with real keyboard and touchpad blind wells, individual thick blank keycaps and inset touch surface, four underside feet, two coaxial fixed hinge barrels, and a separate backward-leaning thick display lid with a true shallow bezel recess occupied by an opaque blank display. One tiny top inset is a static visual detail. All numeric geometry newly authored, no cash-register till, scan table or star-console parts reused. One whole game-art prop and zero scenes, metres and opaque untextured PBR; no software, operating display, communication, electrical circuit, hinge movement, engineering, compatibility or safety claim.
